title: Account statements for a twelve-month period
definition: The statements of the subject account for a full year, so that a pattern can be separated from an episode. It is requested wherever a single transaction or a single month would be a weak basis, and it establishes the baseline against which any deviation is measured.
evidence_to_cite: the statements, with the account identifiers and the full period
the completeness of the period, and any gaps in the record
the baseline pattern derived, and the method used to derive it

sources.citation: Account records used to establish a baseline, summarised in the FinCrime regulatory index.
